title: Army: No impending military operation in Indanan, Sulu

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur, Philippines — There’s no impending combat operation in Barangay Karawan in Indanan, Sulu, according to a statement issued on Saturday by Joint Task Force Orion and the Army’s 11th Infantry Division. The current security activities in the province are targeted law enforcement efforts, the statement stressed. The claim about an impending military operation was circulated by a certain Pando Mudjasan on a social media account, which the military described as “misleading, baseless, and inconsistent with the actual situation on the ground.” READ: PNP eyes replicating peace gains in Sulu’s Indanan in other areas Instead, the Armed […]...
